purpose: Source-backed Boston-area home-care search POC seed data; not a comprehensive directory or provider recommendation.
search_rules: Keep office-distance sorting separate from service-area matching. A nearby office does not establish that a household is served.
Use the nearest geocoded office only for office distance; do not fabricate a point for a null coordinate.
Provider town lists are advertised coverage, not live acceptance. Omitted towns generally mean unknown because these are curated excerpts.

CMS historical ZIPs show at least one patient served during source OASIS collection period. They are positive historical evidence, not a promise of current coverage; absence is not a definitive exclusion.
Label clinical home health separately from privately paid personal care/private-duty nursing.
No star ratings, prices, current vacancies or real-time caregiver availability are supplied.

category_notes.Skilled home health: Clinical nursing/therapy arranged under an appropriate care plan and eligibility requirements; not interchangeable with continuous paid personal care.
category_notes.Private-duty nursing: Individually arranged nursing; staffing, professional scope, orders and payment need confirmation.
category_notes.Personal care / nonmedical home care: Help with daily activities, companionship or household tasks; does not by itself establish Medicare home-health certification.

common_sources.supports: Certified entity identity and office fields; October 21, 2026 release
ZIP file is based on OASIS and one or more patients served during collection period
